description: The main window. The front end listens to the bridge's events (core:event:allow-listen) and drives the undecorated title bar itself; the workspace picker opens a directory dialog. `opener:default` covers external URLs and revealing a file in the file manager; `deliverable_open` needs `allow-open-path` on top of it, because `default` deliberately does not include opening a local path (that is the one opener permission a page could otherwise use to launch anything on the machine).
